situation.en: 25 armed incidents were reported in Ethiopia in the past seven days, 22% fewer than the week before. Most were armed clashs (64%), followed by siege or blockades (12%). 8 of them were carried by two or more outlets. The most reported locations over the past month were Tigray, Amhara and Addis Ababa. UCDP lists 11 active armed conflicts here, the oldest dating from 1974. The most widely covered story this week: “Ethiopian drones hit Eritrean forces accused of backing rebels in Tigray” (Euronews, 2 outlets).
situation.nb: 25 væpnede hendelser ble meldt i Etiopia de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent færre enn uken før. Flest gjaldt væpnet sammenstøt (64 prosent), deretter beleiring eller blokade (12 prosent). 8 av dem ble omtalt av to eller flere medier. De mest omtalte stedene den siste måneden var Tigray, Amhara og Addis Ababa. UCDP fører 11 aktive væpnede konflikter her, den eldste fra 1974. Mest omtalte sak denne uken: «Ethiopian drones hit Eritrean forces accused of backing rebels in Tigray» (Euronews, 2 medier).

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
